BIRDMOD-TRIBAL_FEATHER.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Instinct|Instincts}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
BIRDMOD-TRIBAL_FEATHER.flavor: The only remnant of the tribe.
BIRDMOD-TRIBAL_FEATHER.title: Tribal Feather
BIRDMOD-RITUAL_FEATHER.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Ancestral Guidance|Ancestral Guidances}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
BIRDMOD-RITUAL_FEATHER.flavor: A feather from the tribe, infused with power beyond comprehension.
BIRDMOD-RITUAL_FEATHER.title: Ritual Feather
BIRDMOD-PETAL_FEATHER.description: While your HP is at or below 50%, you have [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] additional [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
BIRDMOD-PETAL_FEATHER.flavor: [outline_size=8][outline_color=white][color=#000000]"Whenever I'm in danger, it makes me feel... light."[/color][/outline_color][/outline_size]
BIRDMOD-PETAL_FEATHER.title: Petal Feather
BIRDMOD-CLOAK_OF_DAGGERS.description: After gaining [gold]Dexterity[/gold] from a card, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Shiv[/gold]{Cards:plural:|s} to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
BIRDMOD-CLOAK_OF_DAGGERS.flavor: [outline_size=8][outline_color=white][color=#000000]"Someone sew shiv sheaths into the inside of this cloak... Seems a bit superfluous, but sure."[/color][/outline_color][/outline_size]
BIRDMOD-CLOAK_OF_DAGGERS.title: Cloak Of Daggers
BIRDMOD-COMBAT_MANUAL.description: After taking unblocked attack damage, gain [blue]{DodgePower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Dodge[/gold].
BIRDMOD-COMBAT_MANUAL.flavor:
[outline_size=8][outline_color=white][color=#000000]"The entire book is just the same sentence, over and over.
Don't get hit."[/color][/outline_color][/outline_size]
BIRDMOD-COMBAT_MANUAL.title: Combat Manual
BIRDMOD-AEROGEL_CALENDAR.description: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{StaggeringPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Staggering[/gold] to ALL enemies that triggers in [blue]{StaggeringHits:diff()}[/blue] hits.
BIRDMOD-AEROGEL_CALENDAR.flavor:
[outline_size=8][outline_color=white][color=#000000]"I have no idea what this is made out of, but I can't damage it in any way.
It feels nearly indestructable..."[/color][/outline_color][/outline_size]
BIRDMOD-AEROGEL_CALENDAR.title: Aerogel Calendar
BIRDMOD-TALON_PACK.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Talon[/gold] to your Deck enchanted with [gold]Adroit[/gold] [blue]{Adroit}[/blue].
BIRDMOD-TALON_PACK.flavor:
[outline_size=8][outline_color=white][color=#000000]"Even though it looks like a toy, it's scarily tough and sharp.
...I feel cool holding it."[/color][/outline_color][/outline_size]
BIRDMOD-TALON_PACK.title: Talon Pack
